counterfactual_missing_items: positive rheumatoid factor or anti-CCP (expected in RA)
decisive_items: She received intramuscular methotrexate (50 mg/m2) on day 1
Shortly thereafter, she noted pain and swelling in both knees
response.rationale: R4 directly links methotrexate administration to the subsequent bilateral knee pain, with afebrile status ruling out infectious causes. R1 lacks the temporal trigger and chronic disease markers, while R6 has no trigger and R3 is contradicted by absence of fever and unremarkable radiograph.

rejected.why: No temporal link to methotrexate; RA is chronic and requires serologic markers.
Afebrile and unremarkable radiograph contradict septic arthritis.
Ectopic pregnancy is the initial diagnosis, not the knee condition.
Reactive arthritis requires a preceding infection, which is absent.
